integrity: Wan's analytic identification of the Kuranishi germ is taken from the primary source. The new algebraic conclusions are proved from the exact homogeneous ideal by an explicit Hilbert--Burch resolution for each three-axis factor, tensor-product resolution, Auslander--Buchsbaum, Hilbert-series arithmetic, and the Stanley--Reisner complex. A standalone verifier independently recomputes the graded Betti table by Hochster's formula and the Hilbert data.
scientific_limitations: The result profiles the semiuniversal fixed-threefold deformation germ before quotienting by automorphisms or S-equivalence. It does not compute a coarse moduli germ. Its commutative-algebra derivation is elementary once the six published quadratic equations are known.
title: Wan's Igusa Kuranishi cone is Cohen--Macaulay of type \(4\)
